notes.title: 1.1.1.0 - Christmas Update
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Christmas Update![/b][/h1]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/me9j60w.png[/img]

Happy Holidays to everyone, regardless of what you celebrate. From today until January 2nd, Sentry Knight Tactics will feature a Christmas event in game! At this time, we will have exclusive new Hero Costumes, Companions, a Christmas themed questline and more!

Help Santa deliver presents, dress up for the holidays, kill a deranged Snowman and more! Again, happy holidays to all and to all a good night!

[h1][b]v1.1.1.0 Patch Notes[/b][/h1]
[list]
    [*][h1][b]New[/b][/h1]
    [list]
         [*]Christmas Event (Dec. 22nd - Jan. 2nd)
         [list]
              [*]Venture on three new seasonal Quests.
              [*]A new, chilling boss fight intended for Level 20 parties.
              [*]Help Santa and the residents of Glacier Gorge celebrate the festivities.
              [*]Find new seasonal Costumes.
              [*]Other fun, holiday themed Items, Companions and goodies to be discovered!
         [/list]
[/list]
[/list]

Please make sure you restart your Steam to verify the game updates properly. Check the version number in the bottom right hand corner of the Main Menu to make sure it aligns with the version listed in this post!
